name: Tàrrega (Spain)
description: Quartered, the first and fourth quarters yellow with four red pales and the second and third chequy of yellow and black of 24 pieces.
history: The official flag of Tàrrega is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, quartered, with the yellow quarters with four red pales and the quarters chequy of 24 pieces, six horizontal and four vertical, yellow and black. The arms were approved on 29 July 1996; the flag official from 1998 to 2008 had the chequy in the first and fourth quarters, and the new proposal published in the DOGC on 8 August 2008 changed the arrangement, giving greater importance to the arms of Catalonia in the first quarter.

features.role: four red pales in the first and fourth quarters
chequy of 24 pieces, six by four, in the second and third quarters
